summary: Loads and initializes a font texture from file a2 with behavior flags a3. Computes allocator flags from the flag bits, queries the current display entry via the dword_8B78A0 display-state global to force a low-resolution flag when the display is small, normalizes and validates the file name against the font-extension table, allocates and dimension-parses the source surface, rounds the surface width and height up to a power of two in 32..2048, allocates a font texture object, and renders the glyph sheet onto it through a clipped render region before replacing the source surface pointer. Stores the flag bits in this[9]; returns 0 on success and -1 on failure.
